propositions: When a Jira workflow forbids a direct transition (e.g., open → done when only open → in_progress → done is allowed), rebar's outbound sync fails and the ticket drifts.
The replay mechanism walks the recorded intermediate hops from append-only STATUS events, forward-mapped to Jira names, to reach the target via allowed transitions.
Current issue status is read from Jira and matched (in Jira-name space) to find resume point; matching is grounded in forward-map only, never inverting LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA.
Replay calls transition_issue_by_name once per remaining hop in order, aborting on any RuntimeError, ValueError, IllegalTransitionError, or HTTPError and falling through to comment-fallback.
The replay call site is in _update_one_scalar_update after widening the exception handler; local_id parameter is added and threaded from mutation to enable event store lookup.
